## Problem

A contractor or field-service operator needs a consistent estimate or planning range from scope, measurements and job costs, with transparent cost build-up, true gross-margin math, uncertainty and commercial lineage.

## Inputs

For public read-only preview: caller-supplied labor hours/rate, materials, equipment, disposal, subcontractor, travel, other direct cost, overhead, contingency, target gross margin, tax and optional uncertainty/site-verification flags. Authenticated workspace also supports service scope, measurements, private company defaults, reusable costs, photos and commercial lineage.

## Outputs

Estimated cost, sell price or range, confidence, assumptions, inclusions, exclusions, warnings and site-review state, with revision and proposal lineage downstream.

## Pricing

No approved public self-service subscription or machine-call price is advertised yet. The read-only planning preview has no checkout or payment side effect.

## Invocation and authority

LIVE VERIFIED PLATFORM HTTPS + MCP: the no-account read-only estimate preview returned HTTP 200 and completed a real deployed HTTPS POST calculation on 2026-09-27. Machine manifest, OpenAPI, llms, full Markdown docs, XML sitemap and problem-intent documents returned intended content types from machineDiscovery function views. Machine Commerce MCP v1.4 then advertised calculate_contractor_estimate_preview in tools/list and a real deployed tools/call flowed through the MCP to EPS and returned the same $5,621.05 sell price, $5,115-$6,635 range and 32% gross margin with side_effects none and persistence none. Independent third-party web verification of Base44 domains, provider-backed billing and independently verified identity/e-sign remain gated.

Rough estimate generation does not authorize sending a proposal, accepting work, charging a customer or creating a customer obligation. The public preview is arithmetic-only and can run without a human UI. Customer self-service typed-name acceptance in the authenticated commercial workflow records the web event against the saved proposal snapshot but is not independent identity verification.

Payment authority: No verified public self-service payment path for external estimator access.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
